notablePrerequisites:
Crystalline Crawler has at least three +1/+1 counters on it.
Deadeye Navigator is paired with Deepglow Skate.
description:
Activate Deepglow Skate by paying {1}{U}, blinking itself.
Deepglow Skate enters the battlefield, trigering itself and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Deepglow Skate.
Resolve the Deepglow Skate trigger, doubling the number of counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.
